messages.text:
What is the definition of insanity hahahaha

Trying the same thing over and over again without change and expecting a different outcome, right?

Ha, that's the famous one! It's often attributed to Einstein, but there's no real evidence he ever said it. It's also been linked to Ben Franklin and Mark Twain, but none of those attributions hold up well either.

The actual clinical/psychological definition of insanity is quite different — it's primarily a legal term (not a medical one) referring to a mental state where someone can't distinguish right from wrong or understand the nature of their actions. It's used in courtrooms, not therapist offices.

But yeah, the "doing the same thing and expecting different results" version has taken on a life of its own. It's a pretty useful shorthand for stubbornness, even if its origins are murky.
